msg.content: Who was the head of government in the countries that won each of the last 5 FIFA World Cups at the time of their victories?
Who was the head of government in the countries that won each of the last 5 FIFA World Cups at the time of their victories?

content.content:
We need to answer: For each of the last 5 FIFA World Cup winners, who was the head of government (i.e., prime minister, president, chancellor depending on country) at the time of their victory. The last 5 World Cups: 2022 (Argentina), 2018 (France), 2014 (Germany), 2010 (Spain), 2006 (Italy). Need head of government at the time of each victory (i.e., the date of the final). Provide name and title, maybe also date. So we need to know head of government for Argentina in Dec 2022, France in July 2018, Germany in July 2014, Spain in July 2010, Italy in July 2006. Let's verify.

Argentina 2022: The head of government is the President (Argentina's system: President is both head of state and government). In Dec 2022, President was Alberto Fernández (since Dec 10 2019). So answer: President Alberto Fernández.

France 2018: France is a semi-presidential; head of government is Prime Minister. In July 2018, the Prime Minister was Édouard Philippe (served May 2017 to July 2020). So answer: Prime Minister Édouard Philippe.

Germany 2014: Germany is parliamentary; head of government is Chancellor. In July 2014, Chancellor was Angela Merkel (since 2005). So answer: Chancellor Angela Merkel.

Spain 2010: Spain's head of government is Prime Minister (President of Government). In July 2010, Prime Minister was José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero (2004-2011). So answer: Prime Minister José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero.

Italy 2006: Italy's head of government is Prime Minister (President of the Council of Ministers). In July 2006, the Prime Minister was Romano Prodi (second term 2006-2008). So answer: Prime Minister Romano Prodi.

We should confirm dates. Could also note that for Italy, the final was 9 July 2006. Prodi took office 17 May 2006. So correct.

Thus answer list.

We might also include the title (President, Prime Minister, Chancellor). Provide a table.

No need to call function. Just answer.

content:
**Heads of government at the moment each nation won the FIFA World Cup (last five tournaments)**  

| World Cup (year) | Winning country | Date of final | Head of government at that time* | Title |
|------------------|----------------|--------------|-----------------------------------|-------|
| 2022 | **Argentina** | 18 December 2022 | **Alberto Fernández** | President (head of state + government) |
| 2018 | **France** | 15 July 2018 | **Édouard Philippe** | Prime Minister |
| 2014 | **Germany** | 13 July 2014 | **Angela Merkel** | Chancellor |
| 2010 | **Spain** | 11 July 2010 | **José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero** | Prime Minister (President of the Government) |
| 2006 | **Italy** | 9 July 2006 | **Romano Prodi** | Prime Minister (President of the Council of Ministers) |

\*The “head of government” is the official who leads the executive branch in each country (president in presidential systems, prime minister or chancellor in parliamentary or semi‑presidential systems). All dates correspond to the day the World Cup final was played, and the listed leaders were in office on those exact dates.
